people.name: Abel
people.line: Adam and Eve's second son, killed by Cain

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.
translations.bsb: to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood that speaks a better word than the blood of Abel.
translations.kjv: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.
